Product Name:


PNY CS2140 500GB M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4x4 SSD


Specifications:

Form Factor: M.2 2280

Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4

Protocol: NVMe 1.4

NAND Flash: 3D TLC NAND

Controller: High-performance controller

Sequential Read Speed: Up to 3,500 MB/s

Random Write (4KB): Up to 540,000 IOPS

Operating Temperature: 0°C – 70°C

MTBF: ~1.5 Million Hours


Features:

PCIe Gen4 high-speed performance

Faster system boot and app loading

Low power consumption

Reliable and durable solid-state design

Ideal for gaming, content creation, and system upgrades
